sections.title: Recent developments
sections.note: Find timely launches, partnerships, and growth signals.
sections.summary: Shopify’s most recent announcements highlight a push into AI‑driven commerce, new partnership channels and expanded product tooling. In mid‑September 2026 the company unveiled the ChatGPT Ads app for its merchants, a collaboration with OpenAI that lets shop owners create, manage and track AI‑generated ad campaigns directly from the Shopify admin and ship those campaigns to ChatGPT’s advertising platform. Earlier in the month, Shopify announced it had partnered with the marketing technology firm AnyMind Group, which has been awarded Premier Partner status after launching a “Commerce DX Project” with Shopify Japan to unify e‑commerce and physical retail for Japanese enterprises. Shopify also rolled out a suite of AI‑enabled shopping experiences, including the Shopify Catalog—a new search infrastructure for agents and the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) that streamlines product discovery across channels—and the Claude Commerce Agents feature that lets conversational assistants browse live catalogs, build carts, and hand shoppers to Shopify checkout. In addition, the platform announced a partnership with Suta, a fellow e‑commerce network, to create the “Shopify Effect” and a collaboration with Meta’s Muse AI shopping agent to allow shoppers to order directly through Facebook and Instagram without visiting a merchant’s website. These initiatives collectively signal Shopify’s strategy of integrating AI agents, expanding partner ecosystems and enriching its core e‑commerce tooling.
